entities.summary: Shin Kyung-sook (b. 1963-01-12, Jeongeup) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Jeongeup and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, authors & novelists, asia.
